'''"A Speeder Bike Built for Two"''' was a [[Music/Legends|song]] which had been written and released into the [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] prior to, or during, the [[Time/Legends|time]] in which the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] known as [[Master-Com]] was [[Administrator/Legends|administrator]] of [[The Wheel/Legends|The Wheel]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]]. Associates who worked with Master-Com during his time as administrator claimed he could often be found whistling the song's tune.<ref name="VSV" />

==Behind the scenes==
"A Speeder Bike Built for Two" was first mentioned in the second entry of ''[[Viva Space Vegas! The History of the Marvelous Wheel]]'', a pair of articles released on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|blog]] in [[2013]] and written by [[Abel G. Peña]] and [[Rich Handley]].<ref name="VSV" /> The song's name is similar to "a bicycle built for two," which is a line in the real-world song [[Wikipedia:Daisy Bell|Daisy Bell]].<ref name="Daisy">{{WebCite|url=http://kids.niehs.nih.gov/games/songs/childrens/daisymid.htm|text=Daisy Bell (A Bicycle Built for Two)|work=National Institute for Environmental Health Sciences - Kids Pages|archivedate=20180618150442}}</ref>
